title: The Lost Necklace
scene: At 5:25 PM, the jeweler's necklace case was emptied. The shop shutter was down from 5:10 to 5:40.

suspects.name: Elsie Wren
suspects.testimony: I was polishing rings at the bench at 5:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The bench camera shows Elsie polishing at 5:23 and 5:29.

suspects.name: Frank Ash
suspects.testimony: I was watching the shutter from inside at 5:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The shutter camera shows Frank's reflection at 5:24.

suspects.name: Greta Lund
suspects.testimony: I was ordering gems in the office at 5:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The office order was submitted by Greta at 5:22.

suspects.name: Hank Pike
suspects.testimony: I was outside the shutter at 5:25 with a package.
suspects.contradiction: The shutter was down and no delivery was logged, and the necklace clasp was in Hank's pocket.
